scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stylus/worker && npm run build --workspace @stylus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @stylus/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @stylus/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @stylus/worker && npm run test --workspace @stylus/web
scripts.worker:pair: npm run build --workspace @stylus/worker && node apps/worker/dist/cli.js pair
scripts.worker:logout: npm run build --workspace @stylus/worker && node apps/worker/dist/cli.js logout
scripts.worker:start: npm run build --workspace @stylus/worker && node apps/worker/dist/cli.js start
scripts.worker:status: npm run build --workspace @stylus/worker && node apps/worker/dist/cli.js status
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
